Each section opens with the record's reproduction headline and any usage
warning ([label definitions](../eos-labels.md)), then the scope and basis of
the stored check. Only recorded content is shown: missing selections, weights,
errors or conventions are unknown, not zero, and are not inferred. Generating
this page fits nothing and changes no classification or source coefficient.
Every record is also listed by identifier in the
[numerical ledger](../primary-eos-refits.md#records), its
[machine-readable form](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/docs/data/primary-eos-refits.json) and the
[source-audit reports](../source-audits.md).

**Curves and residuals** replay the full stored source and reconstructed
coefficients on the same recorded audit inputs. Residual = model − input in
the fitted quantity's native units; for pressure, P(model) − P(input) at each
input volume and temperature (isothermal records use their reference
temperature). RMS is an unweighted descriptive error, not a parameter
uncertainty or the weighted fitting objective. With more than five
temperatures, the minimum, middle and maximum isotherms are drawn; residuals
include every selected row. Error bars appear only where all widths are
recoverable and keep the source meaning, including digitization widths.
No uncertainty band is inferred.

**Coefficient graphs** show stored central values and recorded error widths
in the audit's units; each panel includes zero. They are not observation or
residual plots. Fixed/adopted values are constraints, not recovered values.
Tables round an error to two significant digits when its leading digit is 1
or 2, otherwise one, and the value to the error's decimal place; values
without a positive error show at most six significant digits. Full precision
stays in EOSMAT and the ledger.

## Bykova et al. (2018), combined coesite-I/II/III 300 K BM3

**reproduced** · `coesite_i_iii_bykova_2018_300k_bm3` · `BM3` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/coesite.md#record-coesite_i_iii_bykova_2018_300k_bm3)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Agreement at the source's printed decimal precision.

- Central-coefficient parity is achieved; the author's fit values are reproduced at reported precision. Published central coefficients are reproduced on the recovered 22-row EoSFit export: 21 measured entries plus the derived Cernok (2014) fitted ambient anchor, not 22 independent measurements. All three BM3 coefficients vary, but the anchor's tiny sigma\_P effectively pins V0 in the author-communicated pressure-only 1/sigma\_P^2 objective; sigma\_V is preserved but not propagated. Current-study V/Z is rounded to 0.1 A3 per formula unit. Original EoSFit settings, sigma\_V treatment and covariance/uncertainty parity remain unverified. The older 24-row unweighted failure is a separate historical diagnostic, not the source fit-input reconstruction. Published coefficients are unchanged; this finding does not establish physical accuracy or recommendation.

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** coesite\_i\_iii\_bykova\_2018\_author\_fit\_export
- **Observations:** 22
- **Fit kind:** isothermal\_pv
- **Selection:** All 22 original EoSFit Group 1 inputs: 21 measured entries plus point 15, a derived literature ambient EOS anchor.
- **Objective:** weighted\_pressure\_residuals
- **Weighting:** Sum\[(P\_BM3 - P\_export)^2 / sigma\_P\_export^2\]; sigma\_V preserved but not used. Derived anchor sigma\_P=0.0001 GPa effectively pins V0.
- **Absolute sigma:** True
- **Free parameters:** V0; K0; K0\_prime
- **Fixed parameters:** None declared

### Curves and residuals

![Original/source and refitted curves with pressure residuals for coesite_i_iii_bykova_2018_300k_bm3](figures/coesite_i_iii_bykova_2018_300k_bm3-curves.svg#only-light)
![Original/source and refitted curves with pressure residuals for coesite_i_iii_bykova_2018_300k_bm3](figures/coesite_i_iii_bykova_2018_300k_bm3-curves-dark.svg#only-dark)

| Fit | Pressure RMS error (GPa) |
| --- | ---: |
| Original / source fit | 0.498 |
| Reconstruction / refit | 0.483 |

Both fits use the same 22 recovered audit input rows. **Volume coordinate:** volume\_a3\_z16\_equivalent\_cell. **Row selection:** all rows.

The 22 audit inputs contain 21 measured entries and one derived ambient EOS anchor (export point 15), not 22 independent measurements. The fit uses sigma\_P only; displayed sigma\_V is preserved but not propagated. Published rounded coefficients and the reconstructed coefficients are evaluated on the same literal author-export coordinates.
